entities.summary: Torre Europa formerly known as Torre de Empsa is a high-rise office building in the AZCA business district of Madrid, Spain. Built between 1975 and 1985 by Necso, the tower stands at 121 metres (397 ft) tall with 30 floors and is the 8th tallest building in Madrid.
